judged_text: The `imported_from` footer interpolates `url` directly into an HTML attribute without escaping, so a feed-supplied URL containing a single quote breaks out of the href attribute. `contents << "... #{url}"` — the URL only has to start with http(s)://, so a feed entry with link `http://x/' onmouseover='alert(1)` injects attributes/HTML into the raw_html post rendered with `raw`. Every feed-driven import path (poll_feed, retrieve_topic, disqus.thor) hits this.

adjudication.rationale: In `TopicEmbed.import`, the footer appends HTML using single-quoted attributes with direct interpolation: `contents << "... #{url}"`. The only validation is `return unless url =~ /^https?\:\/\//`, which permits quotes and additional attributes (e.g. `http://x/' onmouseover='alert(1)`). This HTML is then stored in `raw` and the post is created with `cook_method: Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]`, and `Post#cook` returns `raw` directly for `:raw_html`, bypassing cooking/sanitization. The embed view renders `raw post.cooked`, so the injected HTML/attributes would execute. The feed import paths in the diff (`Jobs::PollFeed` -> `TopicEmbed.import`, `TopicRetriever` -> `import_remote` -> `import`, and `disqus.thor` -> `import_remote` -> `import`) all reach this code.
